analysis.title: 从模型竞速走向产品、算力与生态：本期 AI 趋势观察
analysis.lead: 本期共整理 131 条有效信号。下面不是新闻复述，而是把论文、公司、创业与政策放在同一张图里后的编辑性判断。
paragraphs: 研究侧共收录 20 条信号，重点包括 《BACE: LLM-based Code Generation through Bayesian Anchored…》、《Reward Hacking Benchmark: Measuring Exploits in LLM Agents…》。与只看榜单相比，更值得持续观察的是论文能否把 Agent 的可靠性、评测完整性与推理成本一起向前推进。
AI 跨领域贡献收录 16 条，代表性事件包括 《Claude Fable 5 协助找到雅可比猜想的显式三维反例》、《Early progress on accelerating drug development with…》。这类结果会区分官方论文、可核验反例、媒体报道与尚待同行评审的社交平台首发，避免把‘可计算验证’和‘完成学术确认’混为一谈。
中国 AI 板块本期收录 16 条动态，已覆盖 Kimi / 月之暗面、DeepSeek。代表性变化包括 《月之暗面 发布 Kimi K3.1 Pro——迄今最强3万亿级参数模型,11月4日前开源权重》、《DeepSeek 宣布正式开源大规模云服务推理框架 DeepInfer》；竞争正在从单次模型发布延伸到开源策略、Agent 产品入口、国产算力适配和价格体系。
产业侧共有 30 条前沿实验室与大厂动态、14 条关键人物公开信号，另有 13 条创业和 10 条政策安全更新。模型能力、算力供给、创始人判断、产品分发与合规成本正在变成同一个竞争问题。

takeaways.body: 优先关注带公开证明、实验或可复核数据的 AI 科研贡献，并持续更新同行验证状态。

items.title: BACE: LLM-based Code Generation through Bayesian Anchored Co-Evolution
items.summary: BACE treats generated code and tests as co-evolving populations instead of accepting synthetic tests as ground truth. Bayesian belief updates model tests as noisy sensors, while public examples anchor the search and reduce self-validating drift. The authors report strong results on LiveCodeBench v6 across proprietary and open-weight models.

items.title: NTRU Fatigue with Sparse Secrets: From Lattice Geometry to Attack Cost
items.summary: The security of the NTRU lattice exhibits a fatigue transition at a critical modulus q * . When q q * , recovering the dense sublattice spanned by all secret rotations (DSD) becomes cheaper. items.title: QUAPLA : a library for quantum exact linear algebra
items.summary: In this paper, we introduce QUAPLA (Quantum Python Linear Algebra), a new Python package that implements basic finite field arithmetic on scalars and matrices on a quantum computer. More precisely, QUAPLA is a new module of QARTON [36], a recent general-purpose software library for quantum cryptanalysis. QUAPLA extends QARTON by providing, in particular, quantum circuit implementations of the Berlekamp-Massey algorithm and Wiedemann's algorithm for fields of odd characteristic and their extensions, as well as parametrized resource estimates for these circuits.

items.title: Poster:The Galois Orbit Cannot Help the Primal Attack on Module-LWE
items.summary: The automorphisms x ↦ xj of ℤ[x]/(xn + 1) carry a Module-LWE instance to another valid instance, preserve the error distribution exactly, and act as isometries, so a key appears to supply n free samples. We prove that this cannot reduce the block size required by the primal attack. The action is a signed permutation, so each rotated instance yields a unimodular isometric image of the original lattice, fixing every quantity the success condition sees.
